web.title: discover the show - Salon du Chocolat
web.description:
# Your chocolate-filled experience is just around the corner!
Join us at the Salon du Chocolat & Pastry Show from October 28 to November 1, 2026, at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles.

![Chocolate pastry created by chef Jordan Talbot.](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/-/media/Project/Comexposium-Master1/Master1-Chocolat/_banner-paris/patisserie-jordan-talbot.jpg?rev=90fd6253cda14e89b2573d93b97c7f93&w=2000&hash=7C9DBFB7BC7E82416579F493F725A7FE)

## Salon du Chocolat et de la Pâtisserie of Paris & Lyon:    indulge in a unique gourmet and sensory experience!
**The Salon du Chocolat are inviting you to a truly unforgettable gourmet experience.**

![Jeffrey Cagnes and Nina Métayer after their live demonstration. ](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/-/media/Project/Comexposium-Master1/Master1-Chocolat/home-globale/Pastry-Show_24-Nina-Metayer-et-Jeffrey-Cagnes_0024-icb.jpg?rev=6b9edffb911546e5b3e6b0c6b8863bd5&w=685&hash=8B20D3C2760F2E171353B19E3A0BE07A)

## Salon du Chocolat Paris 2026
**October 28th – November 1st, 2026 | Paris Expo Porte de Versailles**

Experience the World’s Largest Chocolate Celebration! **The Salon du Chocolat Paris 2026** honors cocoa in all its richness and creativity.

- Masterclasses by world-renowned pastry chefs
- Live musical show featuring chocolate-made costumes
- Pastry workshops for children and adults
- Spectacular chocolate sculpture exhibitions

web.description:
# Ticket sales are now open!
See you from October 28 to November 1, 2026!

![Chocolate pastry made by Maxence Barbot.](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/-/media/Project/Comexposium-Master1/Master1-Chocolat/_banner-paris/patisserie-maxence-barbot.jpg?rev=d7ea488a9eb94fbe89c4bd19376c8dfb&w=2000&hash=1D634D525C9C52A65E68A32A76048311)

## Ticket sales are now open!
From October 28 to November 1, 2026, the most indulgent culinary experience of the year returns to Paris.

## A glimpse of the experience
The Salon du Chocolat & de la Pâtisserie in Paris brings together the people who breathe life into chocolate today: artisans, chefs, creators, and enthusiasts from around the world.
